name: Daichi Yuuko
source: Protagonist of the earth route and master of the earth type guardian Pochi. A biker with a strong sense of justice traveling throughout Japan. She awakens to her guardian after the hotel she was staying at was attacked and resolves to fight against Egubado ever since.
